text: Cooking is the science and craft of transforming raw ingredients into nourishing meals through precise preparation and heat. One of the foundational elements in almost every dish is the onion, a versatile base that offers layers of flavor. Sliced, raw, or cooked, onions contribute a sweet, umami-rich aroma that invites other ingredients into harmony. As the onion begins to soften, it slowly releases its complex sugars, creating a sweet yet tangy base. Once chopped and sautéed, onions enhance broths, stocks, and sauces, adding depth and body. Subsequently, garlic enters the picture, adding a burst of aromatic intensity. Together, they form a critical duo, each contributing its own flavor profiles and depth to the overall meal, proving that with just a few humble ingredients, cooking can create an entire banquet.
